Platform Features

Everything you need to
dominate GovCon

From discovery to award - one platform built specifically for government contractors.

Profile-Matched Opportunity Search

Search opportunities by keyword, department, sub-agency, office, location, notice type, set-aside, NAICS, contract value, and due date. Results include match scores, deadlines, agency context, and quick actions.

Save and Track Opportunities

Bookmark opportunities worth watching, review saved pursuits in one table, jump back into detail pages, open source links, and remove stale leads when priorities change.

One-Click CMS Handoff

Send qualified opportunities from search into CMS, assign them to team members, and keep ownership clear before response windows tighten.

Visual Capture Pipeline

Manage pursuits from board or list view, move opportunities across stages, update priority, assign owners and reporters, and keep the team aligned on each pursuit.

Dashboard for Capture Priorities

See live metrics for CMS opportunities, submissions, upcoming deadlines, and awards, plus top matches, growing budgets, market updates, and strategic recommendations.

Budget and Market Intelligence

Spot fastest-growing agencies, hot NAICS codes, rolling budget movement, and federal versus state market activity so your business development strategy follows the data.

News, Policy, and Notification Signals

Review policy and budget signals by source, priority, and agency. Keep system and compliance updates visible through an in-app notification center and browser push support.

Team, Roles, and Permissions

Invite team members, assign roles, configure permissions, and control who can manage organization settings and sensitive workflows.

How It Works

Up and winning in 4 steps

From profile setup to pipeline domination - get running in under 10 minutes.

01

Build your organization profile

Enter legal business details, UEI, CAGE, business size, address, NAICS codes, set-aside certifications, core competencies, keywords, preferred agencies, and preferred locations.

02

Find matched opportunities

Search and filter opportunities using your targeting criteria. Review match scores, agency details, set-asides, NAICS, value, due dates, and source links.

03

Qualify and move into CMS

Save opportunities for later, open details, add qualified pursuits to CMS, and assign owners so every opportunity has a next step.

04

Prioritize with intelligence

Use dashboard and analytics signals to focus on agencies, budgets, states, NAICS codes, and policy updates that support your capture strategy.

10

CVE-2023-44487.summary: The HTTP/2 protocol allows a denial of service (server resource consumption) because request cancellation can reset many streams quickly, as exploited in the wild in August through October 2023.

CVE-2025-23419.summary:
When multiple server blocks are configured to share the same IP address and port, an attacker can use session resumption to bypass client certificate authentication requirements on these servers. This vulnerability arises when  TLS Session Tickets https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_ssl_module.html#ssl_session_ticket_key  are used and/or the  SSL session cache https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_ssl_module.html#ssl_session_cache  are used in the default server and the default server is performing client certificate authentication.  

Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.
